# From Campus Map to Exploreable 3D World: Case Analysis and Prompt Practice on Tsinghua Campus

This tutorial uses [Tsinghua World Model](https://tsinghua-world-model.pages.dev/) as an example to analyze how campus buildings, classrooms, and courses are organized in the browser. It also provides a prompt that can be fed into an AI programming assistant to help you create your own interactive 3D campus from a campus map step by step.

This case is a non-official student project. The judgment on its implementation in this article is based on the public web page, front-end code, and resource list examined on October 30, 2026, rather than the author’s development interviews or original engineering source code. The implementation steps in the tutorial are reproduction plans designed based on these evidence, and it does not mean that the author will definitely follow the same process.

## 1. What should we create

The ultimate goal is a browser application: users can rotate, zoom, and click on buildings in the campus overview; view classrooms after selecting a floor; locate the corresponding location after searching for courses; and experience weather and time-driven scene changes. It is recommended to start with one building, one floor, and two classrooms first, and expand the system across the entire school once it works properly.

~~~mermaid
flowchart LR
 A[地图轮廓与建筑资料] --> B[坐标转换与建筑数据]
 B --> C[校园地面和背景建筑]
 D[照片 平面图 人工整理] --> E[重点建筑和楼层模型]
 E --> F[GLB 模型及房间索引]
 G[课程和地点数据] --> H[课程搜索与位置关联]
 C --> I[Three.js 浏览器场景]
 F --> I
 H --> I
 I --> J[校园总览 建筑 楼层 教室]
 K[天气接口] --> I
~~~

## 3. How the buildings and classrooms in the case website are designed

### 3.1 Campus Base Map: Map Boundary + Local Coordinates

The `data/spatial.json` in the public resource contains the campus origin, latitude and longitude projection parameters, as well as the name, center point, polygon outline, holes, source, and accuracy fields of the building. The source record of the file mentions OSM data and Overpass query snapshots; the webpage also shows an OSM attribution.

A feasible approach is to obtain the architectural plan outline, convert latitude and longitude into local coordinates relative to the campus origin, and then stretch the outline into the building shape. When the outline lacks height, additional information should be provided, or it should be clearly marked as an estimate. The map itself does not indicate the layout of each classroom.

The `data/foundation-facades.json` of the project describes the reconstructed facade rhythm of the background facade, and notes that the positions of windows and rooms have not been verified. This indicates that at least some of the background visual details are reconstructed according to a pattern, and should not be regarded as measured for each window individually.

### 3.2 Key Buildings: Separate Models and Registration Data

`models/campus-index.json` points the building ID to their respective `building.json`. The six teaching entries include the building shell `shell.glb`, a overview model, floors, rooms, components, and coordinate alignment information. The translation of translation, rotation, and control points during alignment is used to place the local model of the building itself at the campus map position.

The Six Teach description document clearly states that the building proportions are based on photos, schematic diagrams, and map outlines, not on actual measurement. The document also records the fit residuals between local coordinates and map coordinates; these residuals reflect the fitting quality of the selected control points and cannot be used as an indication of the overall measurement accuracy of the building.

The description file of the legal library also records the script paths that generate models for buildings, furniture, and various detail levels. This provides clues about the procedural generation process; the scripts themselves were not downloaded with this public resource, so it is impossible to reconstruct the author's complete modeling toolchain, nor can we assume that all buildings are generated using the same method.

### 3.3 Classroom: Floor Structure, Room Indexes, and Furniture Layering

The `building.json` of the six teachings records the ID, height, room list, floor model nodes, and individual furniture GLB for each layer. The room records are further associated with room numbers, floors, model nodes, and positioning accuracy. When entering a building, switching floors, or clicking on a classroom, the front end can load or display the corresponding content based on these indices.

Specific example: In the first floor of Area A of Liujiao, there are `FLOOR_A1` nodes, a room list, as well as furniture files for detailed and overview purposes. Floor A5 is marked as reconstructed based on the template of adjacent floors: partitions, passages, and furniture are not measured, and room numbers are also unconfirmed. The description of Liujiao also indicates that some basement rooms have only numbers, and there is no reliable horizontal position.

Therefore, the modeling of a classroom can be understood as follows: first, organize the rooms and corridors based on available floor plans, then construct the floor slabs, walls, doors, windows, and furniture. Finally, bind the geometric model with the room ID. Photos, floor plans, manual reconstruction, and program-generated data may be used together; however, there is no evidence to confirm whether the author used aerial photography, which modeling software was employed, or the specific construction process for each building.

### 3.4 Webpage Rendering: Block-based Loading, Not Loading All Models at Once

The browser uses packaged JavaScript, styles, JSON, and GLB resources. The manifest also includes block-based base terrain and vegetation resources, as well as Web Workers; the same building can provide overview, floor, interior, and furniture resources respectively. This organization enables loading of content based on perspective and interaction stages, reducing the amount of data that needs to be processed from the beginning.

Course data is stored in `data/schedule.json`, including courses, schedules, locations, and sources. Course search is linked to spatial data, allowing the search results to be located on buildings, floors, or classrooms. The specific accuracy depends on whether there are available room mappings for that location.

During local verification, search for "University Physics" to find 23 courses. Click on one result to enter the six classrooms and display 6C102 and F1. The class schedule is a data snapshot and should not be used directly as a basis for real-time class scheduling.

## 4. Creating Your Own Campus: What Materials Are Needed

| Data | Purpose | Minimum requirements at start |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Campus map or OSM building outlines | Building location, outline, roads | One building and its surroundings |
| Building exterior photos | Roof, doors and windows, main entrance, colors | One clear photo from each visible direction |
| Public or licensed floor plans | Room, corridor, staircase relative positions | One floor; if none, use a schematic layout with annotations |
| List of buildings and rooms | Name, alias, floor and room ID | One building, two rooms |
| Course or event schedule | Course search and location association | Just create some sample data |

Record the source, date, permission, and precision for each material. OpenStreetMap data have attribution and ODbL usage requirements; see [ for OSM copyright notes ](https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright); other photos, plans, and models are used under their respective licensing conditions. Do not assume that resources from the case website can be republished automatically: web accessibility and material redistribution are two different things.

## 5. Directly usable Prompt

The following Prompt is executed in stages. Replace the content within square brackets with your school and materials; at each step, let the programming assistant review the current project and complete the verification. You can use Codex, Claude Code, or any other programming assistant that can read and write project files.

### Prompt 1: Build a running 3D minimal project

~~~text
请在当前目录创建一个可运行的 3D 校园网页，使用 Vite、Three.js 和普通 JavaScript。先做最小版本，暂时使用我自己提供或你生成的示例数据，不复制其他网站的私有源码。

目标：
1. 显示地面、两栋不同形状的建筑和名称标签。
2. 使用正交相机，支持鼠标旋转、缩放和平移；点击建筑后显示名称。
3. 建筑数据单独放在 JSON 文件，包含 id、name、footprint、height 和 precision。
4. 使用清晰的低多边形、等距微缩风格，并适配桌面和手机。
5. 提供本地启动方法、依赖清单，并实际运行验证；修复报错。
6. 不要把示例尺寸写成真实测绘数据。

完成后说明修改文件、启动地址和已验证的交互。
~~~

References: [ Creating Scenes with Three.js ](https://threejs.org/manual/en/creating-a-scene.html), [ OrbitControls ](https://threejs.org/docs/#examples/en/controls/OrbitControls), [ Introduction to Vite ](https://vite.dev/guide/).

### Prompt 2: Import map building outlines

~~~text
请为现有项目增加地图数据导入功能。目标校园为 [学校名称]，数据文件为 [GeoJSON 或 OSM 数据路径]，校园参考原点为 [经度, 纬度]。

要求：
1. 解析建筑多边形及可能存在的内洞，转换为相对原点的局部米制坐标。
2. 使用建筑高度或楼层数生成体块；缺失高度时使用可配置默认值，并标记 estimated。
3. 保留原始数据的建筑 ID、名称、来源和许可；页面显示适当署名。
4. 校验建筑坐标、朝向和尺度，输出至少三个可人工对照的地标。
5. 数据解析与渲染分开，保留示例数据供无网络时运行。

先检查输入实际字段，再实现和测试，不要臆造地图里没有的高度或建筑名称。
~~~

Map data can be viewed from [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org/); after getting familiar with data querying, you can refer to [Overpass API documentation](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Overpass_API) to export buildings within the area. For larger areas, a local appropriate projection method should be used, and simple local approximation is suitable for small-scale prototypes.

### Prompt 3: Build a distinctive building

~~~text
请基于我提供的 [建筑名称] 外观照片、平面轮廓与尺寸资料，制作可用于现有 Three.js 项目的建筑模型。

先列出：已确认的轮廓、入口、楼层和材质；缺失或推测的内容。采用程序化几何或 Blender 建模均可，但必须保存生成脚本或可编辑源文件，并导出 GLB。

模型要求：
- 建筑外壳、屋顶、门窗和每层楼分别命名；
- 模型使用米制，说明坐标轴、原点、朝向和尺寸；
- 输出 building.json：id、模型路径、楼层 ID、模型到校园坐标的平移/旋转/缩放、素材来源和精度说明；
- 在校园场景中按至少两个可辨认地标检查位置和方向；
- 对缺失资料使用清晰标注的近似值，不要将视觉推断写成实测。

请实际加载 GLB 并检查外壳、朝向及建筑落地情况，提供截图或明确的验证结果。
~~~

References for modeling tools and formats: [Blender manual ](https://docs.blender.org/manual/en/latest/), [Blender glTF export ](https://docs.blender.org/manual/en/latest/addons/import_export/scene_gltf2.html), [Three.js GLTFLoader ](https://threejs.org/docs/#examples/en/loaders/GLTFLoader). Program-generated models and manually modeled ones in Blender can be used together; repeated windows, floors, and tables are suitable for parametric generation.

### Prompt 4: Constructing floors and classrooms from the floor plan

~~~text
请在 [建筑名称] 中制作 [楼层]，参考资料为 [获授权的平面图/自绘示意图路径]。

1. 从平面图整理房间轮廓、走廊、门洞、楼梯及可确认的尺寸；列出无法确认的部分。
2. 先生成楼板和墙体，再放入门窗、讲台、桌椅；重复家具使用可调参数批量生成。
3. 为楼层和每间房设置稳定 ID，输出 rooms.json，包含 floorId、roomId、名称、位置、模型节点名、来源和 precision。
4. 接入楼层选择；隐藏其他楼层或使用剖切视图，让当前楼层内部可见。
5. 点击房间可高亮并展示名称；返回校园总览时恢复原视角。
6. 缺少真实房号或布局时，用“示意/重建”标识，禁止把猜测映射为真实房间。

使用至少两间教室测试楼层切换、房间点击和返回，并报告结果。
~~~

### Prompt 5: Accessing course search

~~~text
请在现有校园项目中加入课程搜索。先使用 data/courses.json 中的自制样例，字段至少包括 courseId、课程名、教师、星期、时间、buildingId、floorId、roomId 和 sourceDate。

搜索支持课程名、教师、建筑名和房间号。点击结果时，根据 buildingId → floorId → roomId 逐级定位；如果某级未知，定位到已知的最高级并显示“房间位置未确认”。数据加载失败时给出可见提示，避免静默失败。

请测试：正常房间、只有建筑的记录、无结果、中文搜索和返回总览。不要把样例课表显示为实时数据。
~~~

### Prompt 6: Weather, Performance, and Release

~~~text
请为现有项目添加时间与天气效果，并优化加载：
1. 无天气数据时使用可配置默认天气，展示数据时间与状态；提供手动切换晴、雨、雪的预览。
2. 校园总览使用轻量建筑；进入建筑后再加载楼层与家具。重复物件尽量合批或实例化，并处理资源释放。
3. 对桌面和手机分别测试首屏、搜索、切换建筑及 WebGL 失败提示；记录实际测得的加载时间和资源大小。
4. 提供生产构建与静态部署说明。若天气接口需要服务端代理，明确静态托管与代理各自的部署方式，不在前端保存密钥。
5. 检查数据来源、署名、素材使用条件以及真实与重建内容的标记。
~~~

Weather data can be referenced in [ Open-Meteo documentation ](https://open-meteo.com/en/docs). Map data, courses, and weather usually have different update frequencies, so the source and update time should be indicated separately.

## 6. Example of a complete Prompt usage: Building two classrooms from scratch

This set of examples uses fictional campuses and fictional dimensions to allow you to experience the entire process of AI-assisted development. The examples are descriptions of executable tasks, and the following "expected results" are acceptance criteria, not actual screenshots or promises that have already been executed.

### Step 1: Submit the requirements and sample data to the assistant

Open the programming assistant in a blank project folder and paste the complete Prompt below:

~~~text
请在当前空文件夹创建“示例校园 3D 地图”，用 Vite 和 Three.js，完成后运行并验证。所有名称和尺寸均为虚构示意。

校园以米为单位，Y 轴向上，地面为 XZ 平面。使用以下数据：
- 教学楼 A：中心 (-15, 0, 0)，长 24 米、宽 12 米、高 8 米；两层，每层 4 米。
- 图书馆：中心 (20, 0, 0)，长 18 米、宽 14 米、高 12 米；三层。
- 教学楼 A 的一层有 A101、A102 两间教室，之间留 2 米宽走廊；每间教室放 3 行 × 4 列桌椅和一块黑板。房间布置为示意。
- 示例课程“机器人导论”周一 09:00–10:30，在教学楼 A 的 A101；“三维图形基础”周三 14:00–15:30，在 A102。

交互：
1. 初始显示两栋建筑和中文标签；鼠标可旋转、缩放、平移。
2. 点击教学楼 A，显示一层内部；点击 A101 或 A102 可高亮并显示名称。
3. 搜索“机器人导论”，点击结果后进入教学楼 A 一层并定位 A101。
4. 提供返回校园按钮、加载错误提示和手机布局。
5. 把建筑、房间与课程数据分离；README 写明启动方式和“虚构示例”。

请先实现最小功能，再启动并验证以上交互；报告执行过的验证、未完成项和本地地址。
~~~

**Expected check:** Two buildings appear on the page; complete the steps in order: “Teaching Building A → A101”, “Introduction to Search Robot → A101”, “Return to campus”. If the assistant only generates files without execution, continue sending:

~~~text
请启动刚才的项目，在浏览器依次操作校园总览、A101 和“机器人导论”搜索；记录每一步的实际结果与截图。若报错，请修复后重新验证，不要把预期结果写成已完成。
~~~

### Step 2: Have the assistant convert the schematic building into the building in the reference photo

Prepare the visual photos and a floor plan with usage permissions, place them in the `references/` directory of the project, and then enter:

~~~text
请读取 references/ 中的教学楼照片和一层平面图，将现有“教学楼 A”替换为参考资料对应的外观和房间轮廓。先给出一张资料表，区分照片可见、平面图可确认、需要估计的内容；没有尺寸的部分保持可配置的近似值。

保留 A101/A102 的稳定 ID 与搜索功能。先做建筑外壳，再做一层楼板、墙、门洞和家具。保存可编辑的生成代码或建模源文件，导出 GLB 并接入网页。最后截图展示总览、楼层和 A101，核对旋转方向、入口、地面高度和课程定位。
~~~

**How to determine the result:** The building outline and entrance direction should be consistent with the input data; windows, room numbers, or furniture layouts without supporting evidence should be marked as illustrative. If the model direction is incorrect, add: "Please recheck the model coordinate system using the entrance photo and the north-facing map, fix the rotation, and indicate which transformation was modified."

### Step 3: Replace the example with real course data

~~~text
请读取我提供的 courses.csv，只使用其中的 course_id、name、teacher、day、start、end、building_id、floor_id、room_id 字段。先检查缺失值和重复课程，再转换成网页所需的 JSON。

已能匹配房间的结果定位到教室；只有 building_id 的结果定位到建筑，并显示“教室位置未确认”。显示数据来源和更新日期，不要把课表显示成实时占用。请用一条完整记录和一条缺房间记录测试搜索及定位。
~~~

If you don't have the public or authorized schedule, continue using the sample data. At each stage, ask the assistant to show the actual running results, modified files, and unverified parts, and then proceed to the next stage.

## 7. Recommended data organization

Below is a organizational method for self-implementation, not the original source directory of the case project:

~~~text
campus-world/
├── public/
│   ├── data/                # 地图、建筑、房间与课程 JSON
│   └── models/              # 建筑外壳、楼层和家具 GLB
├── src/
│   ├── scene/               # 相机、灯光、渲染与交互
│   ├── map/                 # 坐标转换、轮廓拉伸
│   ├── building/            # 建筑、楼层与房间加载
│   ├── search/              # 搜索与地点映射
│   └── weather/             # 天气状态与降级
├── model-sources/           # 自己的建模脚本或可编辑文件
└── README.md
~~~

You can first use the following sample data to understand the relationships between them. The coordinates and class schedule are fictional data:

~~~json
{
  "buildingId": "TEACHING_A",
  "name": "教学楼 A",
  "model": "models/teaching-a/shell.glb",
  "transform": {"translation": [12, 0, -8], "rotationY": 0, "scale": 1},
  "floors": [{"id": "F1", "model": "models/teaching-a/f1.glb"}],
  "rooms": [{"id": "A101", "floorId": "F1", "node": "ROOM_A101", "precision": "schematic"}],
  "source": "自绘示意",
  "precision": "schematic"
}
~~~

For actual projects, the coordinate system should be standardized: for example, X/Z is used for the campus plan, and Y is used for the vertical direction. Axis conversion is performed when external models are imported. Course data is associated through stable buildingId, floorId, and roomId. Names and aliases are used for searching, but they are not considered the unique primary key.

## 8. Acceptance and Error Diagnosis

1. **Launch**: Access via the development server or static HTTP service provided by the project; do not directly double-click HTML. If the JavaScript module is treated as plain text, check whether the server returns `.js` files in JavaScript MIME type.
2. **Campus**: Verify that the model is visible, buildings are in the correct positions, and mouse and touch operations are available.
3. **Buildings and Classrooms**: Click on buildings, switch floors, select classrooms, and return; check for missing resources or incorrect obstructions.
4. **Search**: Compare a course that can locate classrooms with one that can only locate buildings, and examine the accuracy hints.
5. **Weather and Offline**: The map and local schedule remain usable during network outage, while weather display is unavailable or in cache state; check the weather data timestamp after reconnecting.
6. **Performance**: Record the first-screen latency, model size, and interaction frame rate, then decide whether region-based chunking, model simplification, or on-demand loading are necessary.

## 9. Reference Links

- [Tsinghua World Model Online Experience](https://tsinghua-world-model.pages.dev/): Case websites, non-official student works.
- [Three.js Manual](https://threejs.org/manual/): Scenes, cameras, geometry, and rendering basics.
- [Khronos glTF](https://www.khronos.org/gltf/): Browser 3D model transmission format.
- [OpenStreetMap Copyright and Attribution](https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright): Usage conditions for map data.
- [Open-Meteo API](https://open-meteo.com/en/docs): Weather data interface.

This case provides explorable and queryable campus spaces. If the robot is to move within these spaces, additional collision geometry, physics engine, sensors, and control interfaces are required, and it must be verified for specific tasks.
